import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double mn = 1e9;
        long a = 0, b = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long l = gcdLL((long) y, i);
            long ip = (long) (x * (l / y));
            if (ip % (l / i) == 0) {
                ip /= (l / i);
            } else {
                double vok = ip;
                double pop = (l / i);
                vok = (vok / pop) + 0.49;
                ip = (long) vok;
            }
            double ip2 = ip;
            if (mn > Math.abs(x / y - ip2 / (double) i)) {
                mn = Math.abs(x / y - ip2 / (double) i);
                a = ip2;
                b = i;
            }
        }
        long d = gcdLL(a, b);
        a /= d;
        b /= d;
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long gcdLL(long a, long b) {
        return a * b / gcd(a, b);
    }

    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
